new_mecha_sources.full_source_review: New C08 has a whole raised-arm correspondence: adult inside an open tracking frame and separate robot beyond it holding a corresponding arm similarly. Replacing the two-handed precision repair with pose matching would violate the fixed interaction. A coexisting tracking demonstration adds a separate event and apparatus with broad action/subject effects, while its explicit adult clause has no frozen age witness or local age-change permission. It cannot be reduced to a robot arm or an abstract matching pose. Fully read and skipped; no source-specific pixel qualification claimed.

New A12 is a complete external wearable path on the woman, not biological replacement or the detached robot arm. Alternative A12 explicitly coexists with the original repair and preserves harness→rigid bracket→upper cuff→external elbow hinge→forearm cuff→distinct human wrist over clothing, with the wrist continuing to the original frame grip. Face/hair alone does not bar that wearable. The full option adds a meaningful human/machine echo, but creates a second nearby elbow/cuff chain, six additional connection endpoints and stronger ownership competition at the exact hand/frame boundary under repair. At creativity 1 the baseline's one mechanical target gives clearer hierarchy and contact legibility. A12 is a viable explored whole option, unchosen and skip; no isolated bracket or cuff fragment is carried into the final and no native adoption is claimed.
